titulo: These camera apps give you more control over the iPhone 18 Pro’s aperture
cuerpo: One of the questionable limitations of the iPhone 18 Pro's new main camera with a variable aperture is that you're limited to just four settings in the native iOS' camera app in manual mode: f/1.48, f/1.8, f/2.8, and f/4.
